is_airport_sign.description: true if the photo shows airport signage, a gate sign, a flight screen or a counter sign

visible_text.description: readable printed text, uppercase as printed, one entry per line, reading order

gate_codes.description: gate references as printed: B12, B1-B20, or a bare letter B

explicit_arrow.description: the one arrow clearly attached to the main text, else null

confidence.description: 0.0-1.0 that the text and gate codes are read correctly

location_claim.description: always null: the traveler's location is never inferred
